summary: Track owner-local staging retries without enabling mail expiry

replay.detail: Staging retries keep their first receipt and idempotent outcome; no replay or synthetic consumption receipt is introduced.

schema.detail: Each graph and messages shard gains an owner-local, non-replicated staging-attempt table with last_attempt_at. An atomic, once-only forward migration preserves existing receipts. No registry or wire format changes.

rules.detail: Admitted restaging advances last_attempt_at. Only old unresolved staged rows backfill max(recorded time, migration time), imposing a one-time delay of up to seven days on their eventual expiry. Resolved rows retain recorded times; never-offered and silent waits retain original acceptance times.

compatibility.detail: Readers tolerate absent freshness storage, which is not proof of no attempt. The future acceptor expiry writer must learn freshness only through an answered upgraded-owner read; old builds, timeout and unreachable owners hold mail. The table is not replicated. Existing binaries ignore it; do not enable a writer until all pinned hosts and TypeScript clients have the required readers.

manual.detail: No expiry writer or activation switch is included.

recovery.detail: The migration is forward-only and reopens do not reset attempt times.
